Class CardPicking

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.CardPicking
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CardPicking extends GameState
Card-picking phase of each round: players, iterated in offer-tile order, resolve their claimed OfferTile by drawing the allowed number of cards from the upper and lower rows. Picks are constrained by the offer tile's row quotas and, for BuildingCards, by the player's available food (net of building sale discounts).

The state self-advances: onEntry() and the tail of pickUpCard(Player, Card) both call checkTurnFlow, which moves on to the next player whenever the current one can no longer pick (row quotas exhausted or no affordable building), and transitions to ExtraUpperCardPicking once every offer tile has been resolved.

    • pickUpCard

      public void pickUpCard(Player p, Card c) throws InvalidActionException
      Validates and performs a card pick. Rejects the call when it is not the given player's turn, when the card is not currently on the board, when the player has used up the offer tile's quota for that row, or when the player cannot afford the card. After applying the pick, re-evaluates turn flow.
